The original regression was kept unchanged and passes in the complete Linux suite and both final affected suites. The complete Windows run retained a separate WinError 5 while publishing a campaign; a bounded retry now passes an actual reader-lock control, permanent-error/competing-destination controls and the campaign suite. The original transient lock holder was not identified.

initial_failures.campaign_control: The first real-lock control successfully published both queued cases but checked zero-based paths instead of the existing one-based indices. The control now reads both jobs through Campaign.job, verifies their indices and retained integrity, and passes. No production behavior changed to accommodate this test correction.
